commit 23ba180ad81f9db842662a5490d9da941b7f8980
Author:     Corey Bryant <corey@thunderbird.net>
AuthorDate: Fri Jun 5 10:07:59 2026 -0700
Commit:     Corey Bryant <corey@thunderbird.net>
CommitDate: Fri Jun 5 10:07:59 2026 -0700

    Bug 2038892 - Follow up: Remove orphaned required_signoffs/signoff_urls remnants. r=dandarnell
    
    
    The signoff gating mechanism was removed from upstream. This drops
    the remaining leftovers, including the test fixture parameters,
    the verify_required_signoffs verification, and the required_signoff
    attributes used in signing kind files. We use shipping-phase gating
    now and don't need the previous required_signoffs gating.
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D304880

diff --git a/taskcluster/comm_taskgraph/util/verify.py b/taskcluster/comm_taskgraph/util/verify.py
index 5c4f24332c3..0b4d91b24a7 100644
--- a/taskcluster/comm_taskgraph/util/verify.py
+++ b/taskcluster/comm_taskgraph/util/verify.py
@@ -261,33 +261,6 @@ def verify_dependency_tiers(task, taskgraph, scratch_pad, graph_config, paramete
                     )
 
 
-@verifications.add("full_task_graph")
-def verify_required_signoffs(task, taskgraph, scratch_pad, graph_config, parameters):
-    """
-    Task with required signoffs can't be dependencies of tasks with less
-    required signoffs.
-    """
-    all_required_signoffs = scratch_pad
-    if task is not None:
-        all_required_signoffs[task.label] = set(task.attributes.get("required_signoffs", []))
-    else:
-
-        def printable_signoff(signoffs):
-            if len(signoffs) == 1:
-                return "required signoff {}".format(*signoffs)
-            if signoffs:
-                return "required signoffs {}".format(", ".join(signoffs))
-            return "no required signoffs"
-
-        for task in taskgraph.tasks.values():
-            required_signoffs = all_required_signoffs[task.label]
-            for d in task.dependencies.values():
-                if required_signoffs < all_required_signoffs[d]:
-                    raise Exception(
-                        f"{task.label} ({printable_signoff(required_signoffs)}) cannot depend on {d} ({printable_signoff(all_required_signoffs[d])})"
-                    )
-
-
 @verifications.add("full_task_graph")
 def verify_aliases(task, taskgraph, scratch_pad, graph_config, parameters):
     """
